newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenues rise 2.7 percent for March.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenues rise 2.7 percent for March.

text.p: Georgia revenue collections for March totaled $821.1 million, an increase of 2.7 percent or $21.8 million over March 1996, state Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said.
Collections year to date totaled $7.68 billion, up 6.4 percent or $458.6 million over the July-through-March period last year.
Sales and usage taxes for the year to date rose by 3.3 percent. Individual income tax revenues rose 11.3 percent and corporate income tax revenues rose 1.7 percent for the year to date.
